accessibility_contract: svg role=img with per-panel aria-label + title; track paths aria-hidden; labels aria-hidden (title duplicates); states role=status/alert; stale distinguished by shape/dash/text, never colour alone; no motion (reduced-motion trivially respected); markers non-focusable until P12-7 integration
aspect_contract: viewBox 0 0 1000 1000 + preserveAspectRatio xMidYMid meet; identical geometry at any panel width (390 px verified: 356x356, no page overflow)
availability_presentation: FRESH solid neutral dot; STALE hollow dashed dim dot at authoritative coordinate; UNAVAILABLE no marker (coverage in N NO FIX metadata)
component_contract: SpatialTrackRenderer (pure props: geometry/frame/status/errorDetail/selectedDriverId/trail/headline; no fetching) + CircuitPath/PitLanePath/DriverMarkers/DriverTrail/StateBlock in one file; no replay-page wiring
coordinate_mapping: svg = render * 1000, milli-unit deterministic quantization; exact: 0.25 -> 250, 0.75 -> 750; presentational only
external_svg_policy: julesr0y/f1-circuits-svg NOT integrated (no package/assets/fetch/import/fallback); P12-3 sole authority; cross-validation deferred to P12-9
fixture_inventory: marker pack (synthetic 48-pt loop + pit branch, FRESH/STALE/UNAVAILABLE/off-map/selected)
geometry_identity_policy: geometryMatchesFrame (race + geometry_sha256) gates markers; mismatch renders integrity state, never silent markers
known_limitations: markers non-focusable until P12-7 table integration
labels may visually overlap in dense packs (dots never move)
live harness needs backend + dev-origin CORS (dev-only)
marker_contract: one dot per AVAILABLE driver at exact render_x/render_y; number label preferred, driver-id fallback; labels/selection/overlap never move the dot
motion_policy: discrete authoritative updates only; no transitions, no look-ahead, no interpolation, no prediction-based movement
outside_viewport_policy: rendered unclamped at true coordinates; wrapper overflow-hidden; footer N OFF MAP count
pit_contract: rendered only when pit_status == PIT_GEOMETRY_SUPPORTED, thin subordinate fg-dim stroke; deferred renders nothing
